page.layout: One page of text: a Greek verb-conjugation table with Latin tense headings centred. Latin labels in the left margin ("Statuebā.", "Statui.", "Statuerā.", "Statuī.", "Statul.", "Statuā."). Running head at top. Page number at top left. Signature mark at the bottom right.
page.notes: Greek forms are read from a small, worn scan and are uncertain in breathings, accents and letter shapes; doubtful forms are marked [?]. Margin labels are Latin glosses. The "I M" mark at the foot right is a signature. Show-through from the facing page is ignored. Printed page with faint text from the other side not transcribed.
